$$
y=-x^{2}-5x-2
$$

at the point $\left(-2,4\right)$. Give an exact answer.

$m'=$
{{field-1}}"] [:db/add "29010ba2-70b7-5832-959a-392d77ed4cd8" :question/worked-solution "Let $f(x)=-x^{2}-5x-2$.

Apply the power rule:

$$
f'(x)=-2x-5
$$

The tangent slope at $\left(-2,4\right)$ is

$$
\begin{aligned}
m=f'(-2)&=-2\left(-2\right)-5\\
&=4-5\\
&=-1
\end{aligned}
$$

The normal is perpendicular to the tangent, so take the negative reciprocal:

$$
\begin{aligned}
m'&=-\frac{1}{m}\\
&=-\frac{1}{\left(-1\right)}\\
&=1
\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "29010ba2-70b7-5832-959a-392d77ed4cd8" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "29010ba2-70b7-5832-959a-392d77ed4cd8" :question/answer-fields "981151e0-b847-57d4-bb2b-d31f434bc658"] [:db/ensure "29010ba2-70b7-5832-959a-392d77ed4cd8" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186092384 :knowledge-point/questions "29010ba2-70b7-5832-959a-392d77ed4cd8"] [:db/add "1b4a9ef6-dbca-5e05-92d2-7f41c7084602" :answer/id #uuid "1b4a9ef6-dbca-5e05-92d2-7f41c7084602"] [:db/add "1b4a9ef6-dbca-5e05-92d2-7f41c7084602" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "1b4a9ef6-dbca-5e05-92d2-7f41c7084602" :answer/value "1"] [:db/ensure "1b4a9ef6-dbca-5e05-92d2-7f41c7084602" :answer/validate] [:db/add "da1f960e-d781-548c-b06e-fdea25a71e5c" :answer-field/id #uuid "da1f960e-d781-548c-b06e-fdea25a71e5c"] [:db/add "da1f960e-d781-548c-b06e-fdea25a71e5c" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "da1f960e-d781-548c-b06e-fdea25a71e5c" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "da1f960e-d781-548c-b06e-fdea25a71e5c" :answer-field/choices "1b4a9ef6-dbca-5e05-92d2-7f41c7084602"] [:db/add "da1f960e-d781-548c-b06e-fdea25a71e5c" :answer-field/correct "1b4a9ef6-dbca-5e05-92d2-7f41c7084602"] [:db/ensure "da1f960e-d781-548c-b06e-fdea25a71e5c" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "d93532a0-89ea-5012-9358-b3864546a1c4" :question/id #uuid "d93532a0-89ea-5012-9358-b3864546a1c4"] [:db/add "d93532a0-89ea-5012-9358-b3864546a1c4" :question/problem "Find the slope $m'$ of the normal line to the curve

\begin{aligned}
m=f'(1)&=4\left(1\right)-5\\
&=4-5\\
&=-1
\end{aligned}
$$

The normal is perpendicular to the tangent, so take the negative reciprocal:

$$
\begin{aligned}
m'&=-\frac{1}{m}\\
&=-\frac{1}{\left(-1\right)}\\
&=1
\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "d93532a0-89ea-5012-9358-b3864546a1c4" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "d93532a0-89ea-5012-9358-b3864546a1c4" :question/answer-fields "da1f960e-d781-548c-b06e-fdea25a71e5c"] [:db/ensure "d93532a0-89ea-5012-9358-b3864546a1c4" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186092384 :knowledge-point/questions "d93532a0-89ea-5012-9358-b3864546a1c4"] [:db/add "77e400f4-0130-574b-ac4f-08f4a984545f" :answer/id #uuid "77e400f4-0130-574b-ac4f-08f4a984545f"] [:db/add "77e400f4-0130-574b-ac4f-08f4a984545f" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "77e400f4-0130-574b-ac4f-08f4a984545f" :answer/value "\frac{1}{8}"] [:db/ensure "77e400f4-0130-574b-ac4f-08f4a984545f" :answer/validate] [:db/add "a2c55724-0e24-5ff8-a779-a363394e7665" :answer-field/id #uuid "a2c55724-0e24-5ff8-a779-a363394e7665"] [:db/add "a2c55724-0e24-5ff8-a779-a363394e7665" :answer-field/key "field-1"] [:db/add "a2c55724-0e24-5ff8-a779-a363394e7665" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "a2c55724-0e24-5ff8-a779-a363394e7665" :answer-field/choices "77e400f4-0130-574b-ac4f-08f4a984545f"] [:db/add "a2c55724-0e24-5ff8-a779-a363394e7665" :answer-field/correct "77e400f4-0130-574b-ac4f-08f4a984545f"] [:db/ensure "a2c55724-0e24-5ff8-a779-a363394e7665" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "1e88392e-bd06-5cb1-82b0-30200767c300" :question/id #uuid "1e88392e-bd06-5cb1-82b0-30200767c300"] [:db/add "1e88392e-bd06-5cb1-82b0-30200767c300" :question/problem "Find the slope $m'$ of the normal line to the curve

\begin{aligned}

$$
\begin{aligned}
